name: superdurable-dex
description: Build Dex process products in a repository-backed coding workspace.

interface.shortDescription: Build Dex apps in a coding workspace
interface.longDescription: Developer skills for a coding-agent host with a writable repository or project workspace. Dex App Builder is the implicit entry point; it loads explicit Dex SDK and Dex Connector Contributor specialists when the request requires them. Without repository and command access, the plugin supports planning and handoff only.
defaultPrompt: Use $dex-app-builder to discover, design, and build this Dex process application.
Use $dex-connector-contributor to add <XYZ> to Dex official connector library.
Use $dex-sdk to design a reliable standalone Dex Flow for this application.
Use $dex-app-builder to prototype and build this Dex workflow.
